jobs.title: Director, Revenue Strategy & Planning
jobs.location: Bay Area, CA, United States of America
jobs.description:
Since we opened our doors in 2009, the world of commerce has evolved immensely, and so has Square. After enabling anyone to take payments and never miss a sale, we saw sellers stymied by disparate, outmoded products and tools that wouldn’t work together.

So we expanded into software and started building integrated, omnichannel solutions – to help sellers sell online, manage inventory, offer buy now, pay later functionality, book appointments, engage loyal buyers, and hire and pay staff. Across it all, we’ve embedded financial services tools at the point of sale, so merchants can access a business loan and manage their cash flow in one place. Afterpay furthers our goal to provide omnichannel tools that unlock meaningful value and growth, enabling sellers to capture the next generation shopper, increase order sizes, and compete at a larger scale.

Today, we are a partner to sellers of all sizes – large, enterprise-scale businesses with complex operations, sellers just starting, as well as merchants who began selling with Square and have grown larger over time. As our sellers grow, so do our solutions. There is a massive opportunity in front of us. We’re building a significant, meaningful, and lasting business, and we are helping sellers worldwide do the same.

The Role

We are seeking a Director, Revenue Strategy & Operations to take on the most important and least defined problems facing Block's revenue organization. This is a special projects role. You will be the person our leaders turn to when a question is significant, ambiguous, and needs a rigorous answer.

Your work will be defined by the strategic initiatives that matter most at the time, and it will change as our priorities change. Early on, that is likely to include areas such as sales forecasting, pipeline management, and capacity planning for our non-direct sales organizations. Over time, you may hand work off once it is running well, or take on something entirely new.

This is an individual contributor role. You will lead through analysis, judgment, and influence rather than headcount, partnering closely with Sales Strategy & Operations, Finance, Sales, Partnerships, Services, Data, and Systems. You will report to the Head of Revenue Strategy & Planning within the Revenue organization.

You Will

You will lead the strategic initiatives and special projects that surface across the revenue organization, taking each from an ambiguous question through analysis to a recommendation leaders can act on. The work will change as our priorities change. Some examples of projects you might work on include:

- Building our sales forecasting rhythm, including the methodology, data requirements, cadence, and standard of quality a credible forecast depends on, and driving its adoption across the business.

- Defining how we measure pipeline health and whether we have sufficient pipeline to support the sellers we have hired and the targets we have set.

- Capacity planning for our non-direct sales organizations, translating expected volume into the staffing, ratios, role mix, and hiring timing those teams require.

- Assessing whether an organization is structured and sized efficiently, and recommending how it should change as volume grows.

- Modeling the return we should expect from a partnership, investment, or new commercial motion.

- Shaping commercial deal economics, including what we offer, what we hold back, and the thresholds that should govern non-standard terms.

- Creating process, structure, and clear assumptions in areas where none exist today, and leaving behind something the organization can operate without you.

- Producing executive-ready recommendations that make assumptions, tradeoffs, risks, and required decisions clear in plain language.

You Have

- 10+ years of experience in Strategic Finance, Financial Planning & Analysis, Sales Strategy & Operations, Revenue Operations, management consulting, investment banking, or a related analytical field.

- A track record of owning ambiguous, high-visibility problems end to end, from framing the question through to a recommendation leaders act on.

- Range. You are equally comfortable building a recurring operating process and answering a one-time strategic question, and you can move between them without losing quality.

- Experience with sales forecasting, pipeline analysis, and capacity modeling.

- Strong financial and commercial judgment, and advanced modeling skills in Excel or Google Sheets and SQL. You can work with large, complex data sets and turn them into clear decisions.

- Strong executive communication and cross-functional influence. You can build alignment and drive outcomes without direct authority.

- A bias toward building. You create structure where it is missing rather than waiting for it, and you are comfortable being the first person to work a problem.

Bonus

- Experience in payments, financial technology, usage-based pricing, or another multi-product business with several routes to market.

jobs.title: Finance & Strategy Manager
jobs.location: New York, NY, United States of America
jobs.description:
Block builds simple, powerful tools that make progress towards an economy that's truly open to all. Each of our brands unlocks different aspects of the economy for more people. Square makes commerce and financial services accessible to sellers. Cash App is the easy way to spend, send, and store money. Afterpay is transforming the way customers manage their spending over time. TIDAL is a music platform that empowers artists to thrive as entrepreneurs. Bitkey is a simple self-custody wallet built for bitcoin. Proto is a suite of bitcoin mining products and services. Together, we're helping build a financial system that is open to everyone. Join us.

The Role

We are seeking a Finance & Strategy Manager to join Block's Business Strategic Finance team, supporting our largest strategic commercial partnerships. You'll partner with Financial Operations, Product, Data Science, and Legal to shape the commercial agreements that underpin Square, Cash App, and Afterpay, spanning payment networks, banks, and processors. Your work will directly influence how Block negotiates, prices, and forecasts the costs that flow through every transaction we process. You'll report to a Finance & Strategy Lead within Block's Business Strategic Finance team.

This is a hands-on, high-impact role. You'll shape Block's approach to its most important partners, lead the modeling behind high-stakes negotiations, and own the forecast for one of Block's largest cost lines. Success requires deep analytical rigor, intellectual curiosity, the ability to navigate ambiguity, and the confidence to drive change even when playbooks don't yet exist.

Candidates can sit in any Block office in the US or be remote from any US state with the exception of Alaska.

You Will

- Act as the key Strategic Finance partner for Block's commercial partnership portfolio, owning the financial and strategic narrative for how we manage these relationships and where we take them next.

- Develop Block's point of view on where value sits across our partner relationships, drawing on market trends, competitive intelligence, and internal data to shape what we should be negotiating for and when.

- Lead the financial modeling and deal advisory behind major partner negotiations (pricing tiers, volume commitments, incentive mechanics), from initial framing through term sheet to signed agreement.

- Forecast variable costs across brands, and explain the drivers behind volume and mix shifts that move the rate we pay.

- Drive cross-functional strategic projects (Financial Operations, Product, Data Science, Legal, Accounting) from problem framing through recommendation and execution.

- Distill complex findings into concise narratives and visualizations for executive-level decisions.

- Champion rigorous analytics, building dashboards, SQL queries, and automated reporting to surface insights at scale.

You Have

- 5+ years in investment banking, private equity, strategic or corporate finance, or management consulting (tech or financial-services focus is a plus)

- Experience building the financial analysis behind a commercial negotiation, contract, or partnership, including modeling deal structures and pricing mechanics, and translating signed terms into a forecast.

- Demonstrated intellectual curiosity: you probe beneath the surface and connect seemingly disparate data to form a strategic point of view.

- Ability to build a point of view from incomplete information: reading market and competitive signals, forming a recommendation, and defending it with senior stakeholders.

- Mastery of Excel / Google Sheets and comfort with SQL and modern AI-assisted analytics tools.

- Track record of owning work end to end, from an ambiguous starting question through to decision-making.

- Experience leading projects with multiple cross-functional partners in fast-paced environments.

- Passion for Block's broader purpose of Economic Empowerment and a commitment to building inclusive financial products.

- Experience measuring and articulating the impact of L&D programs on bottom line sales performance.

jobs.title: Global Operations Excellence & Business Operations Lead
jobs.location: Bay Area, CA, United States of America
jobs.description:
Since we opened our doors in 2009, the world of commerce has evolved immensely, and so has Square. After enabling anyone to take payments and never miss a sale, we saw sellers stymied by disparate, outmoded products and tools that wouldn’t work together.

So we expanded into software and started building integrated, omnichannel solutions – to help sellers sell online, manage inventory, offer buy now, pay later functionality, book appointments, engage loyal buyers, and hire and pay staff. Across it all, we’ve embedded financial services tools at the point of sale, so merchants can access a business loan and manage their cash flow in one place. Afterpay furthers our goal to provide omnichannel tools that unlock meaningful value and growth, enabling sellers to capture the next generation shopper, increase order sizes, and compete at a larger scale.

Today, we are a partner to sellers of all sizes – large, enterprise-scale businesses with complex operations, sellers just starting, as well as merchants who began selling with Square and have grown larger over time. As our sellers grow, so do our solutions. There is a massive opportunity in front of us. We’re building a significant, meaningful, and lasting business, and we are helping sellers worldwide do the same.

About the Role

Square is looking for an experienced operations excellence and business operations leader to build the operating system for global seller onboarding. Reporting to the Head of Global Onboarding Operations, this role will create the metrics, planning processes, reporting cadences, capacity models, and continuous improvement mechanisms that help the onboarding organization scale with discipline.

This role closely partners with Onboarding Operational leaders and is designed to create leverage across the full organization. The right candidate is highly analytical, structured, and action-oriented, with the ability to turn operational complexity into clear plans, dashboards, routines, and recommendations.

What You Will Own

Operating Cadence and Business Management

- Build and run the core operating cadence for global onboarding, including weekly, monthly, and quarterly business reviews.

- Create consistent reporting, decision forums, action tracking, and escalation mechanisms across regions and operating models.

- Partner with leaders to turn strategic priorities into measurable plans, milestones, and execution routines.

- Own the global onboarding KPI framework, including activation, time-to-value, NPS, cost-to-serve, SLA adherence, utilization, and quality.

Planning, Capacity, and Financial Support

- Lead capacity planning and workforce modeling across first-party, vendor, and BPO delivery motions in partnership with regional and partner operations leaders.

- Partner with Finance on budget inputs, forecasts, headcount planning, vendor spend analysis, cost-to-serve models, and ROI assessments.

- Support annual and quarterly planning by translating volume, productivity, service quality, and cost assumptions into operational plans.

Process Improvement and Standardization

- Identify friction in onboarding workflows, handoffs, tooling, data quality, and escalation processes.

- Drive process standardization, playbook development, documentation, and continuous improvement initiatives across regions.

- Partner with Product, Enablement, Analytics, and Operations teams to improve systems, automation, and operational effectiveness.

AI Leadership

- Drive the adoption of AI-enabled workflows across the onboarding organization by identifying high-impact use cases, standardizing best practices, and helping teams apply AI to improve quality, speed, consistency, and operational efficiency.

- Build playbooks, training materials, and operating routines that help onboarding teams use AI effectively for tasks such as knowledge management, call/document summarization, process adherence, quality review, performance insights, and frontline enablement.

- Measure the impact of AI-enabled improvements on onboarding outcomes, including time-to-value, cost-to-serve, team productivity, seller experience, quality, and consistency; use findings to scale what works across regions and delivery models.

What We Are Looking For

- 8+ years of relevant experience with a Master’s degree, 12+ years with a Bachelor’s degree, or equivalent experience in operations, business operations, strategy and operations, workforce planning, analytics, or operational excellence.

- Experience building operating cadences, dashboards, planning processes, KPI frameworks, and performance management routines.

- Strong analytical skills and comfort working with operational, financial, workforce, and performance data.

- Experience with capacity planning, forecasting, budget inputs, cost-to-serve analysis, or vendor spend analysis.

- Ability to manage complex cross-functional projects independently while aligning with senior leaders on objectives and decisions.

- Strong process improvement mindset, with experience standardizing workflows and driving measurable operational impact.

- Excellent communication skills, including the ability to turn ambiguous problems into clear plans, tradeoffs, and recommendations.

- Experience in fintech, commerce, SaaS implementation, customer operations, field operations, or scaled services delivery preferred.

- Experience improving workflows and customer outcomes using AI

Why This Role Matters

As the global onboarding organization scales, strong execution requires more than local management. This role creates the connective tissue across the organization: the metrics, planning discipline, insights, and routines that help leaders make better decisions and teams improve faster. By strengthening the operating system, this role improves seller outcomes, team accountability, and the scalability of Square’s onboarding model.

jobs.location: Bay Area, CA, United States of America
jobs.description:
Block is one company built from many blocks, all united by the same purpose of economic empowerment. The blocks that form our foundational teams — People, Finance, Counsel, Hardware, Information Security, Platform Infrastructure Engineering, and more — provide support and guidance at the corporate level. They work across business groups and around the globe, spanning time zones and disciplines to develop inclusive People policies, forecast finances, give legal counsel, safeguard systems, nurture new initiatives, and more. Every challenge creates possibilities, and we need different perspectives to see them all. Bring yours to Block.

The Role

We are looking for a collaborative, curious operations professional with a passion for leading our Legal Innovation & Operations (LIO) team within our Counsel organization. We're looking for a strategic, detail-oriented builder to lead our team operations strategy from vision to execution. You will manage multiple workstreams, from continuing the work to improve the organization's technology and automation initiatives to managing our budget and reducing third-party spend where possible. We will task you with solving problems, optimizing processes, and bringing the power of automation and AI into how our work gets done.

You Will

- Lead the charge on defining and driving our legal tech strategy, including setting the vision, building the roadmap, and delivering tools that make our team faster, smarter, and more connected.

- Oversee our suite of legal systems (like CLM, eBilling, knowledge management and workflow platforms), ensuring they're optimized, well-integrated, and aligned with how the business actually works.

- Manage our core digital platforms, keeping them efficient, intuitive, and budget-conscious.

- Partner across Legal, Policy, IT, Finance, Business Operations and beyond to evaluate and roll out technology and solutions that streamlines work and improves the experience for everyone who touches it.

- Design elegant solutions and connecting the dots between business needs and technology.

- Build and maintain relationships with vendors, ensuring we get measurable value from our tech investments.

- Lead multi-quarter, cross-functional projects that push automation, AI, and data-driven insights deeper into how we deliver our work throughout the organization.

- Help create operational excellence wherever opportunities exist.

You Have

- 8+ years of experience in legal operations, tech strategy, or a related operations-focused role.

- Experience leading automation or AI initiatives that drive measurable improvements.

- Capacity for managing budgets, timelines, and stakeholders, with a sharp eye for detail and follow-through.

- Adaptive communication methods, translating technical detail into clear business value.

- A collaborative and curious mindset, unafraid to experiment or rethink how things are done.

- Familiarity with platforms like DocuSign CLM or workflow automation tools (bonus points for hands-on implementation experience).

- Experience building trust quickly and working well with everyone from senior leadership to individual contributors.

jobs.title: Senior Business Resilience Program Manager
jobs.location: Bay Area, CA, United States of America
jobs.description:
Block is one company built from many blocks, all united by the same purpose of economic empowerment. The blocks that form our foundational teams — People, Finance, Counsel, Hardware, Information Security, Platform Infrastructure Engineering, and more — provide support and guidance at the corporate level. They work across business groups and around the globe, spanning time zones and disciplines to develop inclusive People policies, forecast finances, give legal counsel, safeguard systems, nurture new initiatives, and more. Every challenge creates possibilities, and we need different perspectives to see them all. Bring yours to Block.

The Role

Block’s Business Resilience is part of the Security Governance Risk and Compliance team. The Business Resilience helps ensure that critical products, services, operations, and supporting technology can continue through disruption and recover within expected timeframes. The team partners across business, technology, risk, compliance, legal, regional entities, and third-party teams to identify resilience risks, validate recovery capabilities, support governance expectations, and drive practical remediation.

This role will help operate and mature Block’s resilience program across business continuity, disaster recovery, crisis management, operational resilience, third-party resilience, testing, reporting, and regulatory compliance support. The role requires someone who can translate resilience requirements into clear business and technology actions, communicate risk in a practical way, and support accountable owners through testing, remediation, and governance.

The ideal candidate is also comfortable improving how resilience work gets done. They should be able to identify manual or repeatable workflows, support AI-enabled and automation opportunities, improve reporting and dashboards, help administer resilience tooling, and build scalable templates, evidence processes, and self-service mechanisms that reduce friction while improving quality, auditability, and regulatory confidence.

You Will

- Identify resilience risks across critical services, business functions, technology, and dependencies, including risks introduced by business, regulatory, or industry changes.

- Develop and maintain current, testable business continuity, disaster recovery, and crisis management plans aligned with recovery objectives, strategies, and resource needs.

- Coordinate resilience exercises and recovery tests, report findings, and partner with accountable owners to track remediation through completion.

- Assess third-party continuity and recovery capabilities, identify gaps, and support remediation.

- Communicate resilience posture, open risks, and decisions needed to governance forums, senior leaders, and Boards, and support audit, regulatory, customer, and RFP requests.

- Partner with regional entities, including the UK, EU, and Canada, to align global practices with local requirements and reduce duplication through shared controls, evidence, and reporting.

- Improve resilience workflows through AI, automation, dashboards, templates, and self-service tools, supporting requirements, testing, adoption, and troubleshooting with appropriate data, access, auditability, and human review controls.

You Have

- 6+ years of experience operating or improving global resilience, business continuity, disaster recovery, crisis management, or related risk programs, ideally in financial services or regulated technology.

- Strong knowledge of impact analysis, dependency mapping, recovery strategies, testing, remediation, and governance, with experience applying relevant standards or regulatory expectations (i.e. ISO22301, BS11200, FFIEC, EBA, FCI, CBI, or RPAA).

- Strong project management, organizational, and partnership skills, with the ability to manage deadlines and dependencies and drive cross-functional follow-through without direct authority.

- Excellent communication and analytical judgment, with the ability to translate complex risks and requirements into practical actions for technical, business, executive, and Board-level audiences.

- Comfort using AI, automation, data analysis, and reporting tools, with the ability to learn and administer new platforms, document processes, and translate stakeholder needs into workflow improvements.

- A relevant professional certification, such as those from DRI International or the Business Continuity Institute, or equivalent practical experience.

jobs.title: Senior Manager, GTM Strategy & Operations - Global Sales
jobs.location: Bay Area, CA, United States of America
jobs.description:
Since we opened our doors in 2009, the world of commerce has evolved immensely, and so has Square. After enabling anyone to take payments and never miss a sale, we saw sellers stymied by disparate, outmoded products and tools that wouldn’t work together.

So we expanded into software and started building integrated, omnichannel solutions – to help sellers sell online, manage inventory, offer buy now, pay later functionality, book appointments, engage loyal buyers, and hire and pay staff. Across it all, we’ve embedded financial services tools at the point of sale, so merchants can access a business loan and manage their cash flow in one place. Afterpay furthers our goal to provide omnichannel tools that unlock meaningful value and growth, enabling sellers to capture the next generation shopper, increase order sizes, and compete at a larger scale.

Today, we are a partner to sellers of all sizes – large, enterprise-scale businesses with complex operations, sellers just starting, as well as merchants who began selling with Square and have grown larger over time. As our sellers grow, so do our solutions. There is a massive opportunity in front of us. We’re building a significant, meaningful, and lasting business, and we are helping sellers worldwide do the same.

The Role:

As the Senior Manager, GTM Strategy & Operations, you'll be a strategic partner to senior Sales leadership and own the most consequential decisions shaping how Square's go-to-market organization is structured, prioritized, and scaled. You'll partner with senior leaders across GTM, Finance, Analytics, and Product/Engineering to translate company priorities into clear GTM direction and shape the bets that define Square's revenue trajectory.

This is a hands-on strategic role. You'll define the right questions, bring an independent point of view on where our GTM motion needs to evolve, and influence executive decisions through structured frameworks, financial rigor, and sharp written narrative. You'll also stay close to execution — building prototypes, owning complex cross-functional workstreams end-to-end, and raising the analytical bar across the team.

Your work will shape annual planning and investment strategy, the operating cadence of Sales leadership, the long-range design of Square's GTM motion across segmentation and coverage, and the executive narrative that aligns cross-functional partners around our most important bets. You will report to the Director of GTM Strategy & Operations, Global Sales, and will mentor junior members of the team.

You Will:

Sales GTM Strategy & Planning

- Serve as a thought partner to senior Sales and GTM executives, helping shape business priorities, resource allocation, and performance strategy.

- Partner with Sales leadership and Finance to shape the GTM strategy for the Sales organization, including segmentation, territory design, coverage models, and rep engagement frameworks.

- Own complex, cross-functional strategic initiatives end-to-end: problem framing, business case, stakeholder alignment, execution, and post-launch measurement.

Performance & Business Insights

- Analyze Sales funnel data to diagnose performance gaps and surface initiatives that improve contact-to-close rates, deal velocity, and quota attainment.

- Partner with Analytics and Finance to define KPIs, build executive-ready dashboards, and own the WBR/MBR cadence that keeps Sales leadership close to the business.

- Translate complex analyses into executive-ready performance narratives and recommendations that drive leadership decisions and shape strategic bets.

Cross-Functional Execution & Program Management

- Lead cross-functional workstreams across Sales, Marketing, Product, Engineering, Analytics, and Finance, driving clarity, alignment, and structure through ambiguity.

- Translate business goals into clear technical requirements (PRDs/BRDs) and partner with technical teams to deliver programs on time and to spec.

- Break large, multi-quarter initiatives into pilots and iterations; manage the roadmap in collaboration with leadership and cross-functional partners.

AI, Automation & Process Innovation

- Identify and champion AI-native opportunities to increase Sales productivity across prospecting, lead scoring, deal support, and rep workflow automation.

- Partner with CRM, Systems, and Engineering on the design of process, policy, and system architecture, including routing, SLAs, rules of engagement, and handoffs.

- Stay at the frontier of AI-native GTM tooling and bring proven new approaches into the team's playbook.

- Raise the AI-native operating bar across the GTM Strategy & Ops team — model what hands-on AI fluency looks like for other operators.

Team Leadership & Craft

- Mentor junior members of the GTM Strategy & Ops team; raise the bar on analytical rigor, written communication, and executive-ready output.

- Model the operating standards (ownership, bias to action, builder mindset) that define how the team works.

You Have:

- 8+ years of related experience with a Bachelor's degree; or 6 years and a Master's degree; or a PhD with 3 years experience; or equivalent experience in GTM Strategy, Sales Strategy, Revenue Operations, Business Operations, or Management Consulting — ideally within SaaS, FinTech, or high-growth technology.

- Proven track record of leading global, cross-functional strategic initiatives that drive measurable revenue, retention, or expansion outcomes.

- Demonstrated ability to influence executive-level stakeholders through structured analysis, clear narratives, and strong business judgment.

- Strong commercial instincts ; comfort tying strategic decisions to investment prioritization and revenue outcomes.

- AI-native operating mindset: fluent with AI/LLMs in day-to-day work, hands-on with workflow automation, and energized by shipping real tools that remove manual work from the team.

- Expertise in CRM systems (e.g., Salesforce), GTM analytics tools (Looker, Snowflake, or equivalents), and SQL for independent data analysis.

- Executive-ready written and verbal communication — able to distill complex analyses into clear leadership narratives and board-level recommendations.

- Comfort with ambiguity and a low-ego, ownership mindset — no task is too small, and you're motivated to build the operating system behind a world-class Sales organization.

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Strategic Finance, Commerce Go-to-Market
jobs.location: Bay Area, CA, United States of America
jobs.description:
It all started with an idea at Block in 2013. Initially built to take the pain out of peer-to-peer payments, Cash App has gone from a simple product with a single purpose to a dynamic ecosystem, developing unique financial products, including Afterpay/Clearpay, to provide a better way to send, spend, invest, borrow and save to our 50+ million monthly active customers. We want to redefine the world’s relationship with money to make it more relatable, instantly available, and universally accessible.

Today, Cash App has thousands of employees working globally across office and remote locations, with a culture geared toward innovation, collaboration and impact. We’ve been a distributed team since day one, and many of our roles can be done remotely from the countries where Cash App operates. No matter the location, we tailor our experience to ensure our employees are creative, productive, and happy.

The Role

The Go-To-Market Strategic Finance team partners with leaders across Sales, Marketing, Partnerships, Revenue Operations, Product, and Data to shape how we invest in growth. As Senior Finance Manager, Commerce Go-to-Market, you will partner with the Global Head of Revenue for Cash App, Afterpay, and Clearpay. You will lead financial planning, forecasting, performance management, and investment analysis for the organization.

You Will

- Serve as the primary finance partner to Commerce go-to-market leaders, supporting day-to-day decisions and long-term strategy.

- Lead annual planning, quarterly forecasting, and ongoing performance management across revenue, gross profit, headcount, operating expenses, and key commercial metrics.

- Build driver-based forecasts that connect pipeline, conversion, sales capacity, productivity, pricing, product adoption, transaction activity, and retention to financial outcomes.

- Evaluate investments across Sales, Marketing, Partnerships, channels, and customer segments using business cases, scenario analysis, and return-on-investment frameworks.

- Prepare concise, decision-ready materials for senior leaders and company planning processes.

- Lead and develop finance team members while remaining directly involved in the team’s highest-impact analyses and deliverables.

You Have

- 8+ years of relevant experience in strategic finance, financial planning and analysis, sales or go-to-market finance, investment banking, consulting, or a related analytical role.

- Experience partnering with Sales, Marketing, Partnerships, Revenue Operations, or another commercial organization.

- Experience leading financial planning and performance analysis, with strong modeling skills across forecasting, resource allocation, scenario analysis, and investment returns.

- Strong analytical ability, experience working with complex models, large datasets, and analysis tools (SQL, Python)

- AI-fluency including analysis, insight generation, process automation and improvement.

- Experience in payments, financial technology, merchant services, marketplaces, commerce, or another transaction-based business is helpful.

- 2+ years of people-management experience, including coaching and developing finance professionals.

jobs.location: New York, NY, United States of America
jobs.description:
Block is one company built from many blocks, all united by the same purpose: economic empowerment. We build technology that increases access and independence for sellers, individuals, and artists around the world. Working at Block means working on and across our brands—Square, Cash App, Afterpay, TIDAL, Spiral, and Proto— in roles that connect, enable, and push all of them forward faster.

We’re remote-first by design and operate with intelligence at the center of everything we do. At Block, you'll be challenged by some of the brightest, most creative minds in the industry and have the tools and autonomy to do the most meaningful work of your career.

The Role

Our Strategic Finance team improves financial and operational decision-making across Square. Our team's core value is trust - we build it by making what is complex simple, and we do it with analysis that is accurate and easy-to-understand. Partners appreciate our insight and trust us to help solve difficult problems. We believe good ideas can come from anywhere, and we'll rely on you to work with others, form intelligent opinions, and present your thoughts to decision-makers and company executives.

Reporting to the Director of Strategic Finance for Sales, Account Management and International this role will support our Internal Sales functions, which guide our largest sellers' journeys onto Square.

You Will

- Serve as a strategic advisor and finance partner to Sales leadership, providing data-driven insights and guidance to inform high-impact business decisions.

- Own and evolve financial operating models that deliver deep visibility into go-to-market (GTM) investments, team productivity, and ROI, enabling smarter resourcing and investment choices.

- Drive GTM efficiency and scalability by partnering with cross-functional leaders to identify emerging trends, key performance indicators, and actionable levers for growth.

- Lead high-impact, ad-hoc strategic analyses that support rapid decision-making and unlock value across all growth functions.

- Collaborate cross-functionally with Accounting, Business Intelligence, Marketing, and other teams to assess the financial implications of key initiatives and ensure alignment with company-wide goals.

- Steward operating expense planning and budget processes, ensuring resources are strategically allocated to support Square's long-term priorities and GTM success.

You Have

- 8+ years in strategic or corporate finance, investment banking, private equity, or management consulting; GTM experience is a plus.

- Experience serving as a trusted advisor to senior leaders, using financial analysis and strategic judgment to inform investment decisions and business strategy.

- Proven ability to influence senior stakeholders through crisp storytelling and data-driven recommendations.

- Track record of operating autonomously: defining problems, structuring analyses, and driving to outcomes without clear precedent or a defined playbook.

- Experience leading projects with multiple cross-functional partners in fast-paced environments.

- Mastery of Excel / Google Sheets and comfort with SQL and modern AI-assisted analytics tools.

- Passion for Block’s broader purpose of Economic Empowerment and a commitment to building inclusive financial products.
